name: second-opinion
description: Get an independent second opinion from a different model vendor on a plan, a fork in the road or a finished build, with a reviewer whose job is to break it. Use for plan checks, choosing between two paths, adversarial QA before shipping, and before opening a pull request or adopting someone else's code. Triggers: "/2o", "second opinion", "ask another model", "break this", "review my plan".
